args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's account review. Pellow Home Living is left out. The Coastal channels have nothing on either account, so everything below comes from Moss's Coastal notes and Moss's 2025-11-02 digest. I also found one PHL ticket in your Dec 2025 cutover recap.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics*

• PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). It comes from your Dec 2025 cutover recap. I couldn't confirm its current status.
• No feature requests found.

*Driftmoor Marine Freight*

• Tide-table import macro failure on Terminal B. Engineering gave a manual CSV patch. No ticket number is recorded.

*Check before you use these*
• Moss's 11/2 digest logs #4419 as a Driftmoor barge slip 7 schedule sync ticket under "Puget Sound Operations". The cheat sheet lists #4419 as the PHL report timeout. The same number is used for two different issues, so please check it in the ticket system before the review.
• I can't see the ticket system itself. These lists are only what was written in notes.
